style.name: Psychedelic Poster
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Psychedelic Poster for global-news posters, using fluid optical curves, vibrating complementary colors, warped display type and rhythmic poster geometry while keeping facts and information graphics dominant. Xiazi and Doudou stay small at the edges.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 八个信号把关税、物理型AI、代理经营、港口安全、维和行动、食品标签、海上设施与月球污染连成一张风险图
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者今天要同时校准成本传导、自动化边界、供应链暴露与证据标准
zh-CN.headlineFull: 八个信号把关税、物理型AI、代理经营、港口安全、维和行动、食品标签、海上设施与月球污染连成一张风险图；经营者今天要同时校准成本传导、自动化边界、供应链暴露与证据标准
zh-CN.intro: 加拿大公布对700多种美国商品的反制关税，物理型AI与一人公司代理协作改变工具边界；黑海港口、南苏丹维和行动、印度食品标签、南海设施和月球微生物风险补齐安全与科学信号。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的总览，不是把新闻堆在一起，而是看见风险如何传导。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先圈出今天会改变成本、权限和交付的三件事。

en-US.headlineFact: Eight signals connect tariffs, physics-first AI, agent-run business, port security, peacekeeping, food labels, maritime facilities and lunar contamination
en-US.headlineView: operators need to recalibrate cost transmission, automation boundaries, supply-chain exposure and evidence standards
en-US.headlineFull: Eight signals connect tariffs, physics-first AI, agent-run business, port security, peacekeeping, food labels, maritime facilities and lunar contamination; operators need to recalibrate cost transmission, automation boundaries, supply-chain exposure and evidence standards
en-US.intro: Canada published counter-tariffs on more than 700 US goods, while physics-first AI and agent-run solo businesses shift the tool boundary; Black Sea ports, South Sudan peacekeeping, Indian food labels, South China Sea construction and lunar microbes complete the security and science map.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A real overview shows how risk travels instead of stacking headlines.
en-US.doudouQuote: Circle the three signals that change cost, permissions or delivery today.

sources.title: Canada to impose counter-tariffs on $27.6B of U.S. imports from Sept. 8
NASA finds Earth microbes could survive on the Moon

zh-CN.headlineFact: 加拿大将从9月8日起对700多种美国商品征收15%、25%或50%的反制关税
zh-CN.headlineView: 跨境卖家要按税号和原产地重算到岸价，而不是给整个市场统一加价
zh-CN.headlineFull: 加拿大将从9月8日起对700多种美国商品征收15%、25%或50%的反制关税；跨境卖家要按税号和原产地重算到岸价，而不是给整个市场统一加价
zh-CN.intro: 加拿大财政部称措施将逐项匹配美国关税，覆盖钢铁、食品、电子产品等，并配套75亿加元支持；经营者应立即核对SKU税则、库存来源、DDP报价和退货成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 关税不是一个平均数，它会沿着每个SKU单独传导。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先导出受影响税号，再改价格和补货表。

en-US.headlineFact: Canada will impose 15, 25 or 50 percent counter-tariffs on more than 700 US goods from September 8
en-US.headlineView: cross-border sellers should recalculate landed cost by tariff code and origin instead of raising every price
en-US.headlineFull: Canada will impose 15, 25 or 50 percent counter-tariffs on more than 700 US goods from September 8; cross-border sellers should recalculate landed cost by tariff code and origin instead of raising every price
en-US.intro: Canada's finance ministry says the measures will match US tariffs item by item across steel, foods, electronics and other goods, alongside C$7.5 billion in support; operators should review SKU codes, inventory origin, DDP quotes and return costs now.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A tariff is not an average; it travels through each SKU differently.
en-US.doudouQuote: Export the affected tariff codes before changing prices and replenishment.

sources.title: Canada to impose counter-tariffs on $27.6B of U.S. imports from Sept. 8

zh-CN.headlineFact: Accelerated Understanding发布物理型AI模型，单次测试处理5万亿个数据点
zh-CN.headlineView: AI竞争正从语言推理扩展到芯片、气象、机器人与地质中的时空预测
zh-CN.headlineFull: Accelerated Understanding发布物理型AI模型，单次测试处理5万亿个数据点；AI竞争正从语言推理扩展到芯片、气象、机器人与地质中的时空预测
zh-CN.intro: 创始人称该系统采用神经算子而非Transformer，面向企业处理物理现象，并计划用于芯片材料与温度优化、极端天气预测和能源勘探；这是世界模型路线之外的另一种基础架构押注。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当问题由物理规律主导，语言模型不一定是唯一入口。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先判断任务是文本问题，还是时空场问题。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Accelerated Understanding launched a physics-first AI model tested on five trillion data points in one prompt
en-US.headlineView: AI competition is expanding from language reasoning into spatial-temporal prediction for chips, weather, robotics and geology
en-US.headlineFull: Accelerated Understanding launched a physics-first AI model tested on five trillion data points in one prompt; AI competition is expanding from language reasoning into spatial-temporal prediction for chips, weather, robotics and geology
en-US.intro: The founders say the system uses neural operators rather than a Transformer and targets enterprise physics workloads, including chip materials and thermal optimization, extreme-weather prediction and energy exploration; it is a distinct infrastructure bet beyond language models.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When physics governs the problem, language may not be the only doorway.
en-US.doudouQuote: Decide whether the task is text, or a field changing across space and time.

sources.title: AI that can simulate and understand physics to invent and discover

zh-CN.headlineFact: 本周的一人公司案例显示，代理已开始承接通讯生产、知识库维护和自动化执行
zh-CN.headlineView: 独立经营者的优势不在代理数量，而在任务边界、复核门和失败回滚是否清楚
zh-CN.headlineFull: 本周的一人公司案例显示，代理已开始承接通讯生产、知识库维护和自动化执行；独立经营者的优势不在代理数量，而在任务边界、复核门和失败回滚是否清楚
zh-CN.intro: 一份8月24日发布的案例汇总记录了由代理协作运行的通讯业务和自动维护流程；对一人公司而言，可复制的不是全自动口号，而是把研究、生产、质检和发布拆成可观察的交接链。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司的杠杆，来自清楚交接，不来自无限授权。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 给每个代理写输入、输出、复核人和停止条件。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: This week's one-person-company cases show agents taking on newsletter production, knowledge-base upkeep and workflow execution
en-US.headlineView: a solo operator's edge comes from task boundaries, review gates and rollback, not the number of agents
en-US.headlineFull: This week's one-person-company cases show agents taking on newsletter production, knowledge-base upkeep and workflow execution; a solo operator's edge comes from task boundaries, review gates and rollback, not the number of agents
en-US.intro: A case digest published August 24 documents an agent-supported newsletter business and self-maintaining workflows; the repeatable lesson is not full automation, but an observable handoff chain across research, production, quality control and publishing.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Solo leverage comes from clear handoffs, not unlimited authority.
en-US.doudouQuote: Give each agent an input, output, reviewer and stop condition.

sources.title: The one-person company gets a crew

zh-CN.headlineFact: 俄罗斯称袭击乌克兰黑海港口的5艘船舶、港口设施和燃料储存点
zh-CN.headlineView: 黑海航运风险正在从单船安全扩展到港口、燃料和货运连续性
zh-CN.headlineFull: 俄罗斯称袭击乌克兰黑海港口的5艘船舶、港口设施和燃料储存点；黑海航运风险正在从单船安全扩展到港口、燃料和货运连续性
zh-CN.intro: 俄国防部称在皮夫登尼、敖德萨和乔尔诺莫尔斯克打击货船、油轮及相关设施；路透无法独立核实该说法，承运人与货主仍需提高港口替代、战争险与延误预案。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 航线风险不是一条线，而是船、港、油料和保险组成的系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 为关键货物准备第二港口和延误通知模板。

en-US.headlineFact: Russia said it struck five vessels, port infrastructure and fuel storage at Ukrainian Black Sea ports
en-US.headlineView: Black Sea shipping risk is expanding from vessel safety to port, fuel and cargo continuity
en-US.headlineFull: Russia said it struck five vessels, port infrastructure and fuel storage at Ukrainian Black Sea ports; Black Sea shipping risk is expanding from vessel safety to port, fuel and cargo continuity
en-US.intro: Russia's defence ministry said it hit cargo vessels, a tanker and facilities at Pivdennyi, Odesa and Chornomorsk; Reuters could not independently verify the claim, while carriers and cargo owners still need alternate-port, war-risk and delay plans.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A route is a system of vessels, ports, fuel and insurance, not a line on a map.
en-US.doudouQuote: Prepare a second port and a delay notice for critical cargo.

sources.title: Russia says it struck five vessels in Ukraine's Black Sea ports

zh-CN.headlineFact: 南苏丹琼莱州一支联合国巡逻队遭伏击，2名埃塞俄比亚维和人员死亡、7人受伤
zh-CN.headlineView: 针对常规巡逻的蓄意袭击正在抬高人道通行与地方安全工作的风险
zh-CN.headlineFull: 南苏丹琼莱州一支联合国巡逻队遭伏击，2名埃塞俄比亚维和人员死亡、7人受伤；针对常规巡逻的蓄意袭击正在抬高人道通行与地方安全工作的风险
zh-CN.intro: 联合国称伤者包括3名维和人员、2名南苏丹警察和2名文职人员，并要求迅速调查；今年因恶意行为死亡的联合国维和人员由此增至9人。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 维和行动的可见巡逻，本身也可能成为被瞄准的目标。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 安全计划要把路线规律和暴露时间一起重算。

en-US.headlineFact: An ambush on a UN patrol in South Sudan's Jonglei State killed two Ethiopian peacekeepers and injured seven people
en-US.headlineView: deliberate attacks on routine patrols are raising the risk to humanitarian access and local security work
en-US.headlineFull: An ambush on a UN patrol in South Sudan's Jonglei State killed two Ethiopian peacekeepers and injured seven people; deliberate attacks on routine patrols are raising the risk to humanitarian access and local security work
en-US.intro: The UN said the injured included three peacekeepers, two South Sudanese police officers and two civilian staff, and called for a prompt investigation; nine peacekeepers have now been killed in malicious acts this year.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The visibility of peacekeeping patrols can itself become a target.
en-US.doudouQuote: Recalculate route patterns and exposure time together.

sources.title: Two UN peacekeepers killed in South Sudan ambush

zh-CN.headlineFact: 路透调查发现同品牌食品在印度与英国存在配方和正面警示标签差异
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球品牌的透明度不能只满足最低法规，还要解释同名产品为何不同
zh-CN.headlineFull: 路透调查发现同品牌食品在印度与英国存在配方和正面警示标签差异；全球品牌的透明度不能只满足最低法规，还要解释同名产品为何不同
zh-CN.intro: 报道比较了印度与英国销售的芬达、Maggi和KitKat，并称印度监管方在行业反对后放弃正面警示标签方案；消费者正在把跨市场配方差异转化为信任问题。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 同一个品牌名，会让消费者自然期待同一套解释标准。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把配方、营养和警示差异放进同一张对照表。

en-US.headlineFact: A Reuters investigation found recipe and front-label differences between same-brand foods sold in India and Britain
en-US.headlineView: global brands need to explain why namesake products differ instead of meeting only the minimum rule
en-US.headlineFull: A Reuters investigation found recipe and front-label differences between same-brand foods sold in India and Britain; global brands need to explain why namesake products differ instead of meeting only the minimum rule
en-US.intro: The report compared Fanta, Maggi and KitKat sold in India and Britain and said Indian regulators dropped a front-warning proposal after industry opposition; cross-market recipe differences are becoming a consumer-trust issue.
en-US.xiaziQuote: One brand name creates an expectation of one standard of explanation.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put recipe, nutrition and warning differences in one comparison table.

sources.title: India wanted red flags on sugary drinks and chips; food giants pushed back

zh-CN.headlineFact: 卫星图像显示南海羚羊礁附近的雅公岛出现新设施，分析人士怀疑与预警雷达有关
zh-CN.headlineView: 小型前哨设施可能通过感知、通信和支援功能放大更大基地的覆盖范围
zh-CN.headlineFull: 卫星图像显示南海羚羊礁附近的雅公岛出现新设施，分析人士怀疑与预警雷达有关；小型前哨设施可能通过感知、通信和支援功能放大更大基地的覆盖范围
zh-CN.intro: 路透审阅的商业卫星图像显示建设从3月至4月开始，最新影像拍摄于8月17日；设施用途尚未确定，中国也未承认相关军事基地建设。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 战略变化有时先以几栋小建筑出现在卫星图上。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把已确认、分析判断和未知用途分三层标注。

en-US.headlineFact: Satellite imagery shows new structures on Yagong Island near Antelope Reef, with analysts considering an early-warning role
en-US.headlineView: small outposts can extend a larger base through sensing, communications and support functions
en-US.headlineFull: Satellite imagery shows new structures on Yagong Island near Antelope Reef, with analysts considering an early-warning role; small outposts can extend a larger base through sensing, communications and support functions
en-US.intro: Commercial imagery reviewed by Reuters indicates construction began in March and April, with the latest image taken August 17; the structures' purpose remains uncertain and China has not acknowledged a military-base project there.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Strategic change can first appear as a few small buildings in a satellite image.
en-US.doudouQuote: Label confirmed facts, analysis and unknown purpose as three layers.

sources.title: New installations emerge on islet as China accelerates South China Sea build-up

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA研究认为人类携带的部分微生物可能在月球南极阴影区域短期存活
zh-CN.headlineView: 载人探月必须在到访前建立化学基线，避免把地球污染误判为月球信号
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA研究认为人类携带的部分微生物可能在月球南极阴影区域短期存活；载人探月必须在到访前建立化学基线，避免把地球污染误判为月球信号
zh-CN.intro: 模型显示从陨石坑底到靴印大小的阴影微环境可能形成存活区，最耐紫外线的黑曲霉甚至可承受有限日照；研究强调存活不等于生长繁殖。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 探索者带去的不只有工具，也有会改变证据背景的微生物。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先测基线，再让人和设备进入样本区。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA research suggests some human-carried microbes could briefly survive in shadowed niches near the Moon's South Pole
en-US.headlineView: crewed lunar exploration needs chemical baselines before arrival so Earth contamination is not mistaken for lunar evidence
en-US.headlineFull: NASA research suggests some human-carried microbes could briefly survive in shadowed niches near the Moon's South Pole; crewed lunar exploration needs chemical baselines before arrival so Earth contamination is not mistaken for lunar evidence
en-US.intro: Models found potential niches ranging from crater floors to boot-print-sized shadows, with UV-resistant Aspergillus niger tolerating limited sunlight; the study stresses that survival does not mean growth or reproduction.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Explorers bring not only tools, but microbes that can change the evidence background.
en-US.doudouQuote: Measure the baseline before people and equipment enter a sample site.

sources.title: NASA finds Earth microbes could survive on the Moon
